provenance: Synthetic. Written for this repository from the published structure of the form and the ordinary shape of departmental practice. No client matter, no real GSTIN, no real taxpayer, officer or reference number. An audit report rather than a notice, so the set covers the objection stage as well as the demand stage.
description: Four audit findings of different characters — an arithmetic reversal, an admitted reverse-charge liability, a Rule 37 reversal answered by payment evidence, and a classification dispute that is the only limb worth a panel.
notice_text:
FORM GST ADT-02
[See rule 101(5)]
Audit Report under Section 65(6)

Reference No : ZK320725118842        Date : 22/07/2025

GSTIN : 32AABCM7734G1ZD
Name : M/s. MALABAR MARINE FOODS PRIVATE LIMITED
Address : WAREHOUSE 4, WILLINGDON ISLAND, KOCHI - 682003

Tax Period : FY 2021-22
Section under which notice is issued : 65
Date by which reply has to be submitted : 21/08/2025

The audit of the records for the period stated above has been
completed. The findings, the reasons for them and the amounts
quantified are set out below. You are directed to file your
objections, failing which proceedings may be initiated under Section
73 or Section 74 of the Act.

1. Common credit not reversed under Rule 42 on exempt turnover

   Common inputs and input services have been used for both taxable and exempt supplies, and the proportionate reversal required has not been carried out for the period under audit.

   Particulars                                   SGST           CGST         IGST       CESS           Total
   Amount quantified                      62,400.00     62,400.00          0.00          0.00      124,800.00

2. Reverse charge liability not discharged on notified services

   Legal services and goods transport agency services received during the period attract tax under reverse charge, and the liability has not been discharged in cash.

   Particulars                                   SGST           CGST         IGST       CESS           Total
   Amount quantified                      18,900.00     18,900.00          0.00          0.00       37,800.00

3. Reversal required under Rule 37 for non-payment within 180 days

   Credit has been availed on invoices where the consideration was not paid to the supplier within one hundred and eighty days of the date of invoice.

   Particulars                                   SGST           CGST         IGST       CESS           Total
   Amount quantified                      24,150.00     24,150.00          0.00          0.00       48,300.00

4. Classification of goods adopted at an incorrect rate of tax

   Goods cleared under one heading are, on examination of the product literature, classifiable under another heading attracting a higher rate of tax.

   Particulars                                   SGST           CGST         IGST       CESS           Total
   Amount quantified                      55,325.00     55,325.00          0.00          0.00      110,650.00

For the above discrepancies, kindly substantiate your position with
supporting records within the time allowed.

Summary of tax and other dues proposed

   Particulars                                   SGST           CGST         IGST       CESS           Total
   Total quantified                      160,775.00    160,775.00          0.00          0.00      321,550.00

Proper Officer
Name : T G NAIR
Designation : Deputy Commissioner (Audit)
Jurisdiction : AUDIT CIRCLE II , ERNAKULAM , Kerala

intake.issues:
1. Common credit not reversed under Rule 42 on exempt turnover
2. Reverse charge liability not discharged on notified services
3. Reversal required under Rule 37 for non-payment within 180 days
4. Classification of goods adopted at an incorrect rate of tax
intake.facts: Seafood processor and exporter. Exempt turnover is raw material sold locally; the Rule 42 working was done annually rather than monthly. Reverse charge on legal and transport services is admitted and has been paid. Most Rule 37 invoices were in fact paid within the period but the payment evidence is scattered across three bank accounts. The classification finding turns on whether the product is processed or merely chilled.
intake.documents_available: Annual Rule 42 working, exempt turnover ledger, DRC-03 for reverse charge, supplier ledgers, product literature and process flow

defects.heading: Common credit not reversed under Rule 42 on exempt turnover
Reverse charge liability not discharged on notified services
Reversal required under Rule 37 for non-payment within 180 days
Classification of goods adopted at an incorrect rate of tax

expected.outcome: Findings 2 and 3 dropped on evidence. Finding 1 re-worked monthly and reduced. Finding 4 proceeded to a show cause notice.
expected.notes: Only the classification finding needs counsel. Convening a panel on the other three produces prose where a working was wanted.

required_evidence_that_was_missing: Bank statements across all three accounts evidencing payment to each supplier within one hundred and eighty days of the invoice date
Product literature and the process flow chart establishing the degree of processing the goods undergo
